#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""VLABench texas_holdem controller for the live, no-reset robot episode.

Uses only the client observations and a local Panda kinematic model.  Target
card locations below are reconstructed from the calibrated forward camera and
its depth image.  Invoke one card at a time with --card 6h/7d/8c/9h/10s.
"""
import argparse
import json
import time
import numpy as np
from scipy.optimize import least_squares
from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation as Rot
from rcb_client import Robot

# Franka Panda joint bounds from the robot spec, radians.
LIMITS = np.array([
    [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-1.7628, 1.7628], [-2.8973, 2.8973],
    [-3.0718, -0.0698], [-2.8973, 2.8973], [-0.0175, 3.7525],
    [-2.8973, 2.8973],
])
# Panda joint origins (xyz, fixed rpy) in the base frame.
JOINT_ORIGINS = [
    ([0, 0, .333], [0, 0, 0]),
    ([0, 0, 0], [-np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
    ([0, -.316, 0], [np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
    ([.0825, 0, 0], [np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
    ([-.0825, .384, 0], [-np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
    ([0, 0, 0], [np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
    ([.088, 0, 0], [np.pi/2, 0, 0]),
]
BASE_ROT = Rot.from_euler('z', np.pi/2).as_matrix()
BASE_POS = np.array([0., -.4, .78])
HAND_ROT = Rot.from_euler('z', -np.pi/4).as_matrix()
TCP_OFFSET = np.array([0., 0., .2])

# Face centers in world coordinates from the fixed forward camera depth.
# The card model's front faces face +y; their centers are about z=.86 m.
CARDS = {
    '6h':  {'name': '6 of hearts',       'pick': np.array([ .149,  .002, .867]), 'place_x': .001},
    '7d':  {'name': '7 of diamonds',     'pick': np.array([-.067, -.242, .837]), 'place_x': .053},
    '8c':  {'name': '8 of clubs',        'pick': np.array([ .006,  .028, .850]), 'place_x': .105},
    '9h':  {'name': '9 of hearts',       'pick': np.array([-.089, -.037, .854]), 'place_x': .157},
    '10s': {'name': '10 of spades',      'pick': np.array([-.154, -.030, .859]), 'place_x': .209},
}
MAT_Y = .373
PICK_YAW = -np.pi/2  # align the gripper's finger closing axis with card normal (+/- y)


def fk(q):
    """TCP world pose for the Panda model; matches the reported start pose."""
    T = np.eye(4)
    for a, (xyz, rpy) in zip(q, JOINT_ORIGINS):
        A = np.eye(4)
        A[:3, :3] = Rot.from_euler('xyz', rpy).as_matrix()
        A[:3, 3] = xyz
        J = np.eye(4)
        J[:3, :3] = Rot.from_rotvec([0., 0., a]).as_matrix()
        T = T @ A @ J
    R7 = BASE_ROT @ T[:3, :3]
    Rtcp = R7 @ HAND_ROT
    ptcp = BASE_POS + BASE_ROT @ T[:3, 3] + R7 @ TCP_OFFSET
    return ptcp, Rtcp


def solve_ik(position, orientation, seed):
    position = np.asarray(position, dtype=float)
    orientation = np.asarray(orientation, dtype=float)
    seed = np.asarray(seed, dtype=float)

    def residual(q):
        p, r = fk(q)
        dr = Rot.from_matrix(orientation.T @ r).as_rotvec()
        # Light seed regularization selects a nearby elbow configuration.
        return np.r_[(p - position) * 3.0, dr, (q - seed) * .015]

    result = least_squares(
        residual, seed, bounds=(LIMITS[:, 0], LIMITS[:, 1]),
        max_nfev=700, xtol=2e-11, ftol=2e-11, gtol=2e-11,
    )
    p, r = fk(result.x)
    pe = float(np.linalg.norm(p - position))
    re = float(np.linalg.norm(Rot.from_matrix(orientation.T @ r).as_rotvec()))
    if pe > .012 or re > .06:
        raise RuntimeError(f'IK did not converge: position error {pe:.4f} m, rotation error {re:.3f} rad')
    return result.x


def get_q(obs):
    return np.asarray(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][:7], dtype=float)


def action_rows(q_from, q_to, fingers, step=.025, minimum=8):
    n = max(minimum, int(np.ceil(np.max(np.abs(q_to - q_from)) / step)))
    arm = np.linspace(q_from, q_to, n + 1, dtype=float)[1:]
    grip = np.full((n, 2), float(fingers))
    return np.c_[arm, grip]


def send_path(robot, q_from, q_to, fingers, note, step=.025, minimum=8):
    rows = action_rows(q_from, q_to, fingers, step=step, minimum=minimum)
    print(f'Executing {note}: {len(rows)} steps', flush=True)
    res = robot.submit('joint_position', rows, dt=.1, interpolate='linear',
                       cameras=['forward', 'wrist'], video='none', note=note)
    if res.meta.get('done'):
        raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {res.meta.get('reason')}")
    return get_q(res)


def hold(robot, q, fingers, count, note):
    rows = np.tile(np.r_[q, fingers, fingers], (count, 1))
    res = robot.submit('joint_position', rows, dt=.1, interpolate='linear',
                       cameras=['forward', 'wrist'], video='none', note=note)
    if res.meta.get('done'):
        raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {res.meta.get('reason')}")
    return get_q(res)


def inspect(robot, label):
    res = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward', 'wrist', 'left'], video='none')
    out = f'/app/output/{label}'
    res.save(out)
    print('status', json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)
    print(f'saved {out}', flush=True)
    return res


def pick_one(robot, card_key, stop_after_pick=False):
    card = CARDS[card_key]
    obs = robot.get_obs(cameras=['forward', 'wrist'], video='none')
    q = get_q(obs)
    p0, r0 = fk(q)
    measured = np.array(obs.meta['proprio']['now'][16:19], dtype=float)
    print(f"{card['name']}: start TCP {np.round(measured, 3)}, model {np.round(p0, 3)}", flush=True)

    r_pick = Rot.from_euler('z', PICK_YAW).as_matrix() @ r0
    p_pick = card['pick']
    p_pre = p_pick + np.array([0., 0., .15])
    q_pre = solve_ik(p_pre, r_pick, q)
    q_pick = solve_ik(p_pick, r_pick, q_pre)
    q_lift = solve_ik(p_pre, r_pick, q_pick)

    q = send_path(robot, q, q_pre, .04, f'{card_key} pregrasp')
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_pick, .04, f'{card_key} descend')
    q = hold(robot, q, .002, 12, f'{card_key} close gripper')
    inspect(robot, f'after_{card_key}_grasp')
    if stop_after_pick:
        return q
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_lift, .002, f'{card_key} lift')

    # Carry upright above the mat, turn the card horizontal while well clear,
    # then lower its center to the tabletop and release.
    place_flat = np.array([card['place_x'], MAT_Y, .782])
    place_high = place_flat + np.array([0., 0., .22])
    q_carry = solve_ik(np.array([card['place_x'], MAT_Y, 1.03]), r_pick, q)
    r_place = Rot.from_euler('x', np.pi/2).as_matrix() @ r_pick
    q_turn = solve_ik(place_high, r_place, q_carry)
    q_place = solve_ik(place_flat, r_place, q_turn)
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_carry, .002, f'{card_key} carry above mat')
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_turn, .002, f'{card_key} rotate flat')
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_place, .002, f'{card_key} lower to mat')
    q = hold(robot, q, .04, 10, f'{card_key} release')
    inspect(robot, f'after_{card_key}_place')
    # Retract clear of the released card while retaining a safe flat-hand pose.
    q_clear = solve_ik(place_flat + np.array([0., 0., .18]), r_place, q)
    q = send_path(robot, q, q_clear, .04, f'{card_key} retreat')
    return q


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument('--card', choices=CARDS, required=True)
    parser.add_argument('--pick-only', action='store_true')
    args = parser.parse_args()
    robot = Robot()
    print(json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)
    pick_one(robot, args.card, stop_after_pick=args.pick_only)
    print('finished', json.dumps(robot.status()), flush=True)


if __name__ == '__main__':
    main()
